parameters.name: DomainNames
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain names for which you want to delete configurations. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). Note the following limits:

- You can specify up to 20 domain names in a single request.

- The product of the number of domain names and the number of function names must be 50 or less.

parameters.name: FunctionNames
parameters.description: The names of the functions whose configurations you want to delete. Separate multiple function names with commas (,). You can specify up to 50 function names in a single request. For more function names, see [Domain configuration function parameters](~~410622~~).
